name: the-control-centre
title: The control centre
scope: The .controlcenter folder, what configuration it holds and what interface speaks for it. Excludes per-launch documents such as launch.json (see launch-and-run).

statements.statement: I have also decided to provide a flightdeck/.controlcenter which can keep active env like LAUNCH_DIRECTORY
statements.context: Describing what worked about launch.json and what to add to it.

statements.statement: control center yes probably, but eventually it will hold all types of configs (especially when flightdeck absorbes dev-workspace) this can be advanced as needed.
statements.context: Asked whether the control centre was worth having at all.

statements.statement: .controlcenter is an inert folder, the interface should be "flightcrew.yml"
statements.context: Second of the worked examples in the turn that defined what an interface is.
